data.short_description: The Carriage House is a European-inspired café opening in phases at the former Secret Garden Bar & Café space in Denver's Cheesman Park neighborhood. Phase one launches July 28 with a café menu and patio, while phase two in September will add a full cocktail bar and remodeled indoor space. The café is owned by John Goscha and Jake Riederer, with a menu developed alongside 2025 James Beard semifinalist Melissa Yanc.

data.location: 3500 E. Parmer Lane, Unit 1164, Austin, TX 78754
data.status: four-month build-out currently underway, targeting a possible opening in October
data.short_description: District 1 Coffee & Co. is a Vietnamese-Japanese fusion coffee concept planning to open in Austin's East Village. Founded by Hue Nguyen and Scott Chu, the brand blends Vietnamese coffee tradition with Japanese matcha and hojicha tea culture. A permit was recently approved and a four-month build-out is underway.

data.location: 1150 Spring St. NW, Suite 175, Atlanta, GA 30309
data.short_description: 14th & Spring Cafe will open in a 3,275-square-foot space in the lobby of the 14th & Spring office building. The café will have 86 seats and operate Monday through Saturday from 7:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. The ownership team did not respond to requests for additional details prior to publication.

data.store_name: Opal Banquet Hall (formerly The Palms Banquet Hall)
data.short_description: The Palms Banquet Hall at 1108 E. March Lane is changing ownership, with new owner Raman Bhatti of RBRM Group planning to rename it Opal Banquet Hall. The acquisition is still in escrow, expected to close by end of July or early August 2026. A Type 47 On-Sale General Eating Place liquor license has been filed with the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control.

data.location: 163 East 86th St (between Lexington and Third avenues), New York, NY 10028
data.status: Slated for a mid-to-late fall opening
data.short_description: ID Hot Yoga has signed a lease for its eighth location on 86th Street on the Upper East Side of Manhattan. The new studio is described as the company's most ambitious project to date and will feature signature high-intensity, music-driven classes in heated rooms. The opening is slated for mid-to-late fall 2026.

data.status: plans to open locations in the Las Vegas Valley
data.short_description: Hot Dog on a Stick has been acquired by Amazing Brands, led by Las Vegas businessman Stephen Siegel, through a bankruptcy court-approved transaction. The brand plans to open locations in the Las Vegas Valley, including a flagship on the Las Vegas Strip, though no specific sites have been announced. Initial growth will be through corporate-owned locations, with franchising planned for the future.

data.store_name: Del Buono's Bakery x DiBartolo's Kakery
data.short_description: Del Buono's Bakery and DiBartolo's Kakery are partnering to open a combined bakery in the former McMillan's Bakery space at 15 Haddon Ave. in Haddon Township. Del Buono's owner Tom Whitman purchased the building last year and invited cake artist Al DiBartolo to join, bringing together two long-established South Jersey bakery brands. The debut is planned for summer 2026.

data.status: preparing to open its doors in downtown Cincinnati later this year
data.short_description: Mizu Sushi & Sake Lounge is preparing to open in the former Lalo Chino Latino Kitchen space at 26 W. Court St. in downtown Cincinnati. The restaurant is owned by husband-and-wife duo Tracy and Kevin, with Kevin serving as sushi chef drawing on Chinese-Japanese heritage and over a decade of culinary experience. The couple relocated to Cincinnati after Kevin visited and fell in love with the city.

data.store_name: Pho Hoa & Jazen Tea Palm Beach
data.short_description: Pho Hoa & Jazen Tea Palm Beach has officially opened at 6716 Forest Hill Blvd in Greenacres, with grand opening celebrations scheduled for July 18 and 19. The location is part of the globally recognized Pho Hoa chain, established in 1983, and is owned and operated by Minh Hoang and his wife. Grand opening week promotions run July 13–19 for Pho Hoa Loyalty App members.

Condado Tacos is planning a location at the Fairlane Green Shopping Center at 3100 Fairlane Drive in Allen Park, MI. No opening date has been announced, and the Allen Park location is not yet listed on the chain's website. The restaurant will join planned Cava, Jersey Mike's, and Shake Shack locations at the new development.

Green Farm Juicery is closing its current location at 2727 Erie Ave. in Hyde Park Square as part of a relocation, after the building was sold as part of a major redevelopment project. The owner, Mara Boord, aims to close one day and open in the new space the next day to minimize customer disruption.

data.status: construction expected to begin once permits are approved, hoping to welcome customers by the end of the summer
data.short_description: Green Farm Juicery is relocating to 3431 Edwards Road in Hyde Park Square, taking over the former Macaron Bar space. The new location is approximately 500 square feet, about half the size of the current restaurant, which the owner says better suits the grab-and-go business model. Construction will begin once permits are approved.

San Francisco-based Sana'a Cafe has signed a lease at 1050 Wilshire Blvd in Los Angeles as part of ongoing expansion in the LA area. The café specializes in Yemeni coffee and offers classic espresso beverages, specialty drinks, and food items including baklava and biscoff milk cake. The brand currently has 13 locations across California and one in Washington.

Sana'a Cafe has a second Los Angeles-area location on the way at the Resa residential complex at 300 Pacific Ave. in Long Beach, with signage already up in the windows. The San Francisco-based brand specializes in Yemeni coffee culture and has at least 11 more locations in the works across California. Franchising in Florida, Michigan, Texas, and California is planned for 2027.

data.location: 1531 Wilshire Blvd, Unit A, Santa Monica, CA 90403
data.short_description: Wellside Cafe is planning to open in the former Cafe Zella space at 1531 Wilshire Blvd, Unit A, in Santa Monica. Owner Mary Anne Roberto aims to revive the atmosphere of Cafe Zella, offering coffee, breakfast, and lunch, with additional grab-and-go options and appeal to nearby healthcare workers from UCLA Santa Monica Medical Center.

data.location: Long Farm Village, off Airline Highway, Baton Rouge, LA (Address not specified)
data.status: expected to open within the next 18 months
data.short_description: Hawaiian Bros Island Grill is preparing to make its Louisiana debut with a planned freestanding location at Long Farm Village off Airline Highway in Baton Rouge. Om Ohana Baton Rouge Realty LLC recently purchased a 0.75-acre site for the restaurant. No specific construction timeline or opening date has been announced yet.

data.status: targeting a mid-October opening pending final building and permitting approvals
data.short_description: Parish & Pour is preparing to open a Cajun restaurant and lounge concept at 7122 Florida Blvd in Baton Rouge, in the former BR Furniture Outlet space across from Bon Carré. The restaurant will feature Cajun cuisine, a full-service cocktail bar, an outdoor oyster bar, and live music. Owners are targeting a mid-October 2026 opening pending final building and permitting approvals.

Bluebird Distilling is undergoing a major renovation at 100 Bridge St. in Phoenixville, rebranding as Bluebird Distilling & Dough House with a redesigned space and new full kitchen. The transformation includes a new bar area approximately four times the original size, a lounge and dining area with exposed brick and Japanese wood interiors, and a dedicated retail area. The kitchen will offer small and large plates alongside neo-Neapolitan-style pizzas made with imported Italian stone-ground flour.

data.store_name: Candy Land Café (pop-up at Bayside Kitchen + Bar)
data.short_description: Bayside Kitchen + Bar in Little Italy, San Diego has been temporarily transformed into a Candy Land-themed pop-up café created in partnership with Hasbro. The limited-time experience opened July 9, ahead of San Diego Comic-Con 2026, and will remain open through October 4, 2026. The pop-up features themed décor, specialty menu items, interactive activities, and exclusive merchandise.

data.location: 1010 W Peachtree St NW, Atlanta, GA 30309
data.short_description: LowCountry Steak, an upscale Southern steakhouse co-founded by Chef G. Garvin and restaurateur TC Mosby, has permanently closed its Midtown Atlanta location. The restaurant announced the closure on social media following its final dinner service, offering no explanation for the closure. Employees reportedly learned of the closure via a group chat the morning after the last service.

Olive Branch is a women-owned concept scheduled to open July 30 beneath the Somm Hotel & Spa in Woodinville. Owned by Breanna Beike and Kelly Trace, it will combine an all-day café, scratch bakery, coffee bar, mercantile, and catering operation with seasonal menus sourced from local farms. The concept also includes a curated retail space featuring gifts and products from local makers.

data.location: 1220 N Hwy A1A Ste 101, Indialantic, FL 32903
data.short_description: A new pub called The Local Beer and Wine Collective is preparing to open in Indialantic's Seaside Centre shopping mall in the coming weeks. The venue will offer Caribbean-inspired food developed by Chef Steve and Sous Chef Roj, alongside craft beer and curated wines. The space features high-top tables and a dog-friendly front patio with seating for twenty to thirty guests.

data.location: 1011 S Ft Thomas Ave, Fort Thomas, KY 41075
data.status: expected to open in August following renovations
data.short_description: Traveler's Table is a new globally inspired dining concept from husband-and-wife team Challis and Lauren Hodge, set to replace Grassroots & Vine in Fort Thomas. The restaurant will serve rotating dishes from a variety of global cuisines, including imported conservas, flatbreads, empanadas, Moroccan dishes, and Mediterranean fare. It is expected to open in August after renovations are completed.

La Ventana de Pasta is a new "Mexitalian" concept from chefs Danielle and Alessandro Zecca, blending Mexican and Italian culinary traditions. The restaurant will be one of the culinary additions to Katella Commons, a 50,000-square-foot food hall coming to OCVIBE. The food hall is scheduled to open in early 2027 as the culinary centerpiece of the $5 billion OCVIBE mixed-use entertainment district.

data.status: expected to debut during the first weekend of August
data.short_description: Molainín Distilling is preparing to open in Seattle's Greenwood neighborhood as both a working distillery and neighborhood pub. Founded by Bryan Benson, the concept is inspired by traditional English and Irish pubs and will feature house-made spirits, cocktails, pub fare, and bottles to take home. The name is derived from the Irish word for "little hill," referencing both Greenwood and Benson's family roots in County Clare, Ireland.

data.status: expected to open before the end of the year
data.short_description: 1926 Coffee Co. is a new cafe planned for the ground floor of Jacksonville's historic Barnett Building, owned by Becovic Management Group. The cafe concept pays homage to the Art Deco building's 1926 origins, featuring a themed menu with drinks named after the building and era. An opening date before year-end has been mentioned, though a representative was not immediately available for comment.

data.status: permanently closing at the end of this month
data.short_description: Taste of Europe, a highly rated Eastern European restaurant in Arlington founded in 2002, has announced its permanent closure at the end of July. The restaurant cited low foot traffic as the reason for closing, having previously shut down in summer 2024 and reopened in November 2024 due to financial issues. The restaurant gained national recognition after appearing on Food Network's Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives in 2012.

data.location: 2346 W Beaver St, Jacksonville, FL (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Zoe Caribbean Grill is a new food truck set to launch in the Jacksonville area, serving Haitian food and beverages. The truck's home base will be at 2346 W Beaver Street at Empowered Kitchen, a non-profit business incubator. Co-owner Markens Redon confirmed the truck will be situated at the flea market near the military base (MWR Mayport flea market).

data.status: expected to open sometime next month
data.short_description: Cafe 55 is a new restaurant opening at 13799 Beach Blvd in Jacksonville, confirmed by owner Qiwei Sun. The owner indicated the cafe is expected to open sometime next month but declined to comment further on the menu. The restaurant will join an existing dining community that includes Time Out Sports Grill, Daruma Japanese Steak House, and La Nopalera Mexican Restaurant.

data.status: working to get it open sometime in the month of August
data.short_description: Pure Green, a healthy juice, smoothie, and bowl franchise, is opening a new location at Suite 130 in Sarasota's University Town Center. Franchise owner Murali confirmed the location is expected to open sometime in August 2026. The menu will feature superfood smoothies, cold-pressed juices, acai and pitaya bowls, and sourdough toasts.

data.location: 103 Gulf Dr N, Bradenton Beach, FL 34217
data.short_description: Popular barbecue food truck T-Bone's Famous Smokin' Bar-B-Que appears to be transitioning to a brick-and-mortar restaurant at 103 Gulf Drive N in Bradenton Beach. Plan review paperwork was submitted by T-Bone's Famous, LLC, and the brand's website confirms it is "Coming Soon" at that address. Owner Trevor Peres was not immediately available for comment on the plans.

A second Sarasota location of Fresh Monkee, a healthy shakes franchise, is planned to open at 6597 S Tamiami Trail in the Sarasota Pavilion shopping center. The first Sarasota location soft-opened on June 1 at 5045 Fruitville Road. The new location will join big-name retailers including Nordstrom Rack, Michaels, and SKECHERS.

data.status: plans to open 30 restaurants across metro Atlanta
data.short_description: QDOBA has signed a new franchise agreement to open 30 restaurants across metro Atlanta as part of a broader plan to add more than 100 restaurants across the southeastern and western United States. The Atlanta expansion will be led by an experienced restaurant operator who previously owned and operated numerous McDonald's locations in the region. No specific addresses or opening dates were provided in the article.

Chef Adrian Kercuku is opening a new Italian concept called La Colina in Lenox Hill on the corner of First Avenue and 74th Street in New York. The restaurant will take over the former Gnocchi House Bar space, accommodating 62 guests across 23 tables and a seven-seat bar. Kercuku plans to retain the experienced service staff from the previous establishment.

Olamaie, a Michelin-starred Austin restaurant known for contemporary Southern cuisine, is closing after 12 years, with its final service on July 19. Owner Michael Fojtasek announced the closure via social media, thanking guests and community members. The restaurant opened in 2014 and received a Michelin star in the inaugural 2024 Texas Michelin Guide.

Calypso is a new restaurant planned for a Chinatown cellar space at 11 Doyers St., combining East Asian and Latin American flavors with dishes such as char siu croquetas, plantain dumplings, and wok-tossed Lomo Saltado. The restaurant will feature 13 tables, a standalone bar, and plans for DJs up to eight times per month. The owners also plan to accommodate private parties, with daily doors opening at 4 p.m. and service extending until 2 a.m. most nights.

data.status: opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Casa Fuego is a modern Mexican restaurant planned for a two-story space at 99 Stanton St. in the Lower East Side, with table seating for approximately 150 guests. The menu will include fresh tuna tostadas, duck confit tacos, and Chilean sea bass, alongside signature cocktails and curated tequila or mezcal flights. The owners are seeking a full liquor license and plan to feature occasional DJs and live music.

Dear Annie, a natural wine bar and restaurant in Cambridge, MA, will close on July 31 after five years of operation. Owner Lauren Friel cited motherhood, changing industry dynamics, and the evolving Boston restaurant scene as reasons for the closure. The restaurant plans to remain closed in August before reopening in September as an events-focused venue.

data.location: San Francisco International Airport, Harvey Milk Terminal 1, San Francisco, CA 94128
data.short_description: The Melt, a San Francisco-based fast-casual chain, opened its first airport location at Harvey Milk Terminal 1 at SFO on July 8, marking its 24th overall location. The airport location features the brand's signature MeltBurger, sandwiches, fries, hand-spun shakes, and airport-exclusive offerings including a breakfast menu. The company has plans to reach 30 locations across California and Arizona by the end of the year.

data.location: 2270 Lone Star Dr, Sugar Land, TX 77479
data.status: opening its first Sugar Land location on July 11
data.short_description: Insomnia Cookies is opening its first Sugar Land location on July 11, marking the brand's 33rd store in Texas. The launch event will begin at noon on July 11 and continue until 3 a.m. on July 12, with free cookies offered to new rewards members. The bakery's menu includes warm cookies, ice cream, brownies, blondies, vegan options, and limited-time flavors.

Sip & Forage Food Cart Pod is a new food cart pod opening in August at 1900 SW 5th Ave in downtown Portland, near the Portland State University campus. The 20,000-square-foot, fully fenced lot will accommodate up to 20 food carts, along with covered outdoor seating, natural gas hookups, high-speed internet, and a full bar cart on-site. The project has been in development since late 2025.

data.location: Address not specified (current downtown Chico location)
data.short_description: Sophi'z Kitchen & Bar is relocating from its current older downtown Chico building to a new address in August. Owner Sophia Ahmed cited years of challenges including air conditioning and plumbing issues at the existing location. The move will close the current spot as the business transitions to its new home.

Sophi'z Kitchen & Bar is relocating to 800 Bruce Road, Suite 100 in Chico, next to Bellachino's, with owner Sophia Ahmed announcing an August opening. The new location will feature brand-new air conditioning, ample parking, and a larger space to support the restaurant's growth. Ahmed has invited her loyal community to support the business through the costs of the move and improvements.

Babcia Bread, a Portland pop-up bakery known for its artisan pastries, is opening a permanent location at 10909 SE Main St in downtown Milwaukie inside the historic Perry's Pharmacy Building. Co-founders Tommy Celt and Jade Novarino are behind the concept, with Celt focused on fermentation and locally milled flours and Novarino co-founding a no-till farm supplying ingredients. The new location will share the building with fellow newcomers Sadie's on Main and Salon Fernweh.

data.status: plans to be customer-ready this autumn
data.short_description: Breadie's Cafe, a coffee shop and bakery concept from Chris and Karin Conlee, will open inside One City Church at 120 N East Yates Road in Memphis. The main restaurant, seating about 80, is expected to open later this year, while an open porch seating 70 is planned for spring 2027. The cafe will offer breakfast, lunch, and to-go dinner options and also feature a private dining room for events.

data.location: 2801 Windy Ridge Pkwy SE, Suite 100, Atlanta, GA 30339
data.short_description: The Baking Social, a new experiential baking concept from chef Shane Quillin (of Sugar Shane's), is set to open in a 3,600-square-foot space at 2801 Windy Ridge Pkwy SE, Suite 100 in Atlanta. The concept will offer twelve signature baking classes ranging from sourdough to cupcake decorating, guided by chefs, alongside a 1,000-square-foot bakery serving baked goods and coffee. Quillin is partnering with Atlanta-based brand incubator Founders Row to bring the concept to life.

Alice on the Avenue, a new neighborhood bar and gathering spot, is opening on August 8 at 1416 SE Morrison Street in Portland, confirmed by owner Sheila Baraga. The concept features an indoor garden aesthetic with shared plates, a full bar, and an all-ages atmosphere, alongside a whimsical cocktail list inspired by Alice in Wonderland. This is Baraga's seventh business, following beloved Portland concepts including The Green Room, The Empire Room, and The Sapphire Hotel.

Dave's Hot Chicken is set to open a new location at the Northshore Mall in Peabody, Massachusetts, slated for mid-August 2026. The fast-casual Nashville-style hot chicken chain will be located on the Promenade, next to Amigo's Mexican Kitchen & Tequila Bar. Franchisee Almerindo Graziano, who signed an agreement in 2021 to develop 10 Dave's locations in the northwest Boston region, is behind this location.

data.location: 6301 Silver Dart Dr, Mississauga, ON L5P 1B2, Canada
data.status: exact opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Mary Brown's Chicken is preparing to open a new location at Toronto Pearson International Airport Terminal 3 in Mississauga at 6301 Silver Dart Drive. The airport location is part of the brand's broader expansion strategy into smaller and non-traditional formats in transit hubs, malls, and mixed-use developments. An exact opening date has not yet been announced.

The Get Down Lounge is coming to 1429 SE 37th Ave in Portland's Hawthorne neighborhood, with owners Jake and Shela Kagan targeting a mid-August opening in the former 3 Doors Down restaurant space. The roughly 2,400-square-foot spot is undergoing cosmetic updates and has a liquor license application filed. Jake brings nearly 30 years of bar experience, including co-ownership of Mr. Bing's, a historic North Beach bar in San Francisco.

Evil Cooks, a Los Angeles-based heavy-metal-themed Mexican street food concept from husband-and-wife team Alex Garcia and Elvia Huerta, is slated to open at Katella Commons food hall inside OCVIBE in Anaheim in early 2027. The new outpost will mark the brand's first Orange County location, joining an expanding lineup of acclaimed operators at the 50,000-square-foot market hall. Evil Cooks has earned two consecutive James Beard Award nominations and appeared on the Los Angeles Times' 101 Best Restaurants list.

data.status: opening timeline has not yet been revealed
data.short_description: Bacio di Latte is preparing to open a new location at Bella Terra at 7821 Edinger Ave., Suite 134, in Huntington Beach, though no official opening date has been announced. Founded in 2011 by Italian brothers Edoardo and Luigi Tonolli, the brand is known for handcrafted Italian-style gelato made fresh daily using high-quality ingredients. The Bella Terra location marks another expansion in Bacio di Latte's continued growth across Southern California.

A new restaurant called LARACLETTE is planning to debut at 1061 Broxton Ave in Westwood, per a recent ABC filing. The restaurant will serve Swiss comfort food with "a modern, gourmet twist in the heart of Los Angeles," according to its website. Further details regarding the menu and opening timeline remain unclear at this time.

Gemini, a new bar concept, has plans to join Terminal South at 1161 Ridge Ave. SW in Atlanta, with liquor license paperwork filed. The 735-square-foot open-air cafe will seat 60 and operate Thursday through Saturday, offering cocktails, beer, and wine. No official opening date has been announced.

A second full sit-down cafe in Virginia-Highlands is planned for the end of the year, as part of a national rollout.

BoostBerry Açaí & Smoothies is opening a Seaport District location at 21 Drydock Avenue in Boston on August 4, 2026, inside a custom-designed container in front of the Reebok gym at the Innovation & Design Building. The brand imports its açaí directly from Brazil and makes its base with just three ingredients. Co-founder Bárbara Brussolo confirmed the expansion.

It is expected to debut around the time Rice performs at KEMBA Live! in August.

The concept originates from Madrid's legendary Chocolatería San Ginés, founded in 1894, and will serve signature churros paired with Spanish hot chocolate, coffee, and pastries. An exact opening timeline has not been announced.

data.short_description: Burger Baron is opening a new location at 828 S Hicks Road in Palatine, Illinois, with an opening planned for fall or winter 2026. The Louckes family, who operates Burger Baron in Chicago at 1381 W Grand Avenue, is expanding to the suburbs again after their Arlington Heights location closed in 2023. An official opening date has not yet been announced.

The Lambs Club Restaurant, a fine dining establishment inside the Chatwal Hotel in New York's Theater District, announced it will permanently close on July 25. The restaurant, founded by chef Geoffrey Zakarian, thanked the Broadway community for their support via Instagram. The space will subsequently be taken over by a new restaurant called The Wolseley Restaurant.
After The Lambs Club Restaurant closes on July 25, its space will be taken over by The Wolseley Restaurant. No additional details about the new restaurant have been announced.

Molly Moon's Homemade Ice Cream is opening its 13th scoop shop at Northgate Station in Seattle at the base of the Everis apartment building. The new location will feature significantly more indoor seating than existing shops. The company opened its first Kirkland location this year and plans to open another location in 2028.

data.status: construction is underway with plans to open later this year
data.short_description: Luma, an all-day cafe led by owner Owen Bernstein, will open at 128 Columbus St. in downtown Charleston. The cafe plans to serve house-made baked goods, fresh breads, sandwiches, and an all-day brunch menu. An official opening date has not been announced, though construction is underway.

data.short_description: Quan Hapa will close its current location at 1331 Vine St. after more than a decade, with its final day of service on July 26. The restaurant is relocating and rebranding as Yo Di, a new Vietnamese kitchen and bar from the Lang Thang Group. The move was prompted by space limitations at the current location.

Yo Di, a new Vietnamese kitchen and bar from the Lang Thang Group, will open at 1135 Vine St., the former Taste of Belgium space, in Over-the-Rhine. The new restaurant will nearly triple the footprint of the prior Quan Hapa location, expanding from approximately 1,100 to more than 3,200 square feet. The concept will focus on authentic Vietnamese flavors, a full bar, and an atmosphere suited for socializing.

data.location: 42768 Grand River Ave Ste 100, Novi, MI 48375

The 4,500-square-foot restaurant features Wagyu dining, seafood, wines, caviar, and private dining rooms. An official grand opening and ribbon-cutting date has not yet been announced.

data.status: expected to open in 2029, pending final approvals

The 3,823-square-foot restaurant is expected to open in 2029, pending final City Council approvals. The restaurant will feature Broncos memorabilia and a menu inspired by players and franchise history.

The Granola Bar, a Connecticut-based restaurant brand, is opening a full-service flagship restaurant on Madison Avenue in Manhattan on July 9. The 2,500-square-foot space seats approximately 90 guests and includes a bar and private dining room. The location will serve breakfast, brunch, lunch, dinner, and classic cocktails.

The 1,000-square-foot location is designed for customers seeking quick meals and will also sell the brand's packaged products. The two Manhattan openings together give customers near Grand Central a choice between full-service dining and grab-and-go.

El Fish Demon, a San Antonio seafood restaurant, announced its permanent closure on July 7 via social media. The restaurant had rebranded from Tacopolis SA to El Fish Demon in April 2026, just three months prior to closing. No official reason for the closure was shared by the team.

data.status: first dirty soda shop will open sometime in August

The first location is expected to open sometime in August, marking the first Swig locations in Chicagoland. Some locations are still in early negotiation stages and have not been announced.

data.short_description: Procida, a southern Italian restaurant from chef Valeriano Chiella, is preparing to open at 2000 Burgundy Street in Marigny, New Orleans in August 2026. The menu will be rooted in the flavors and traditions of southern Italian cuisine.

data.status: signed a lease in Tampa's West River neighborhood
data.short_description: Supernatural Food & Wine has signed a lease for a new location in Tampa's West River neighborhood, expanding from its current home at 305 E Polk St. The new location will focus on donut production and will include a storefront, though it may be smaller than the original.
